QuestInfo.name: In Plain Sight
QuestInfo.0: Feng has sent word through Lan Yi.
QuestInfo.1: Feng apparently uncovered a temple that holds records about Wu Shen. Go to #m875000100#.
QuestInfo.2: This must be one of those 'right under your nose' moments. The temple said to be holding the records of Wu Shen was on Candlewick Peak, located at the edge of Xuanshan.
